title: Does anyone walk past the whole store? #shorts
description:
Larson, Bradlow & Fader (International Journal of Research in Marketing, 2005) analysed 8,751 shopping-cart paths in one US supermarket (data from 2001): none of the long trips covered all twelve aisles (FACT, about one store, not every store).

The whole story: https://www.youtube.com/@zerounderstands

#shorts #howitworks #supermarket
